## Summary
- harden file-transfer Android smoke evidence parsing so unrelated instrumentation summaries cannot satisfy the subcheck
- accept the two known file-transfer UI smoke classes and current connected-test summary formats
- document that this remains readiness evidence and does not close Android/macOS product E2E

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_android_smoke tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_manifest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v
- cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew --no-daemon testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.FileTransferProductOwnerTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.FileTransferSessionTest
- make file-transfer-android-smoke EVIDENCE_DIR=.build/evidence/file-transfer-android-smoke

## Notes
- Did not start the macOS Host or Vibe Screen GUI.
- Did not request Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Keychain, or other TCC paths.
- Did not run adb reverse tcp:54321.
- The default gate invocation remains blocked without real Host/product evidence.


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Tests**
  - Strengthened Android file-transfer smoke-test validation to confirm recognized UI tests, executed test counts, successful results, and absence of failure or skipped-test indicators.
  - Added coverage for dialog-based results, unrelated or warning-only output, failed summaries, and multiple supported log formats.
  - Updated test fixtures with realistic successful ControlBar and file-transfer dialog instrumentation logs.

- **Documentation**
  - Updated validation guidance to reflect expanded Android file-transfer evidence requirements.

title: Harden file transfer Android smoke evidence gate
